result.other_findings: 42.3% of patients were managed at some point in a trauma unit.

result.setting: Repatriation General Hospital, Daw Park; tertiary teaching hospital
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.dates: Hip fractures over 18 months and wrist fractures over 30 months
cycle1.result: 32% had BMD measured and 39% were offered osteoporosis treatment

result.other_findings: Only 34% received information from the medical profession; calcium alone made up 60% of treatments.

result.topic: Bisphosphonate exposure classification in atypical femur fractures
result.setting: Swedish population cohort and Kaiser Permanente Southern California cohort
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Sweden: no extra exposure found, 38/172 (22.1%) BP-naive; KPSC: prior BP use found in 20/29, BP-naive fell from 9.5% to 2.9%

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: 22 hospitals in England, Wales and Scotland
result.standard: BOAST guideline for paediatric ACL injuries (2022)

cycle1.result: 65% of centres use acute knee pathways; 68% collaborative imaging pathways; 59% radiological growth monitoring; 30% report functional outcomes; <50% report re-rupture rates; 74% adhere to rehabilitation protocols

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Effect of hip fracture audit on outcomes
result.setting: Ten Dutch hospitals; Dutch Nationwide Trauma Registration
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Pre-implementation cohort; outcomes reported only as adjusted comparison with 2017

result.intervention: Implementation of the Dutch Hip Fracture Audit in 2017

cycle2.result: 30-day mortality adjusted OR 1.23 (95% CI 0.93–1.63); no difference in length of stay (-0.002) or time to surgery (0.292)

result.other_findings: Outcome comparison rather than audit against a standard.

result.topic: Hip fracture care against national standards
result.setting: Large tertiary hospital, Beijing
result.standard: UK Blue Book standards, compared with National Hip Fracture Database 2012 (180 UK hospitals)

cycle1.result: 66% admitted to orthopaedic ward within 24 h; 8% surgery within 48 h (UK 83%); 10% no surgery; 27% orthogeriatric assessment (UK 70%); 0.3% osteoporosis assessment (UK 94%); 3.8% falls assessment (UK 92%)

result.other_findings: New pressure ulcers in 2% versus 3.7% in the UK.

result.topic: Supracondylar fracture nerve and vessel documentation
result.setting: North Manchester General Hospital; district general hospital
result.standard: BOAST guideline for supracondylar fractures

cycle1.result: ED: capillary refill 65%, radial pulse 59.2%, individual nerve function 37.9%; pre-op nerve function 42.7%; 2 mm K-wires 53.3%; post-op pulse/CRT 27.2%, nerve function 9.7%

result.intervention: Supracondylar fracture assessment proforma and focused educational sessions

cycle2.result: ED: capillary refill 95.5% (p=0.0038), radial pulse 95.5% (p=0.0009), nerve function 72.7% (p=0.0040); pre-op nerve function 50%; 2 mm K-wires 89.5%; post-op pulse/CRT 54.2%, nerve function 50%

result.other_findings: Medial wire technique documentation rose from 82.9% to 100% and post-fixation stability from 42.7% to 89.5%; pre-op nerve documentation stayed low.

result.topic: Fundamentals of nursing care in hip fracture
result.setting: University hospital in southern Sweden; national hip fracture quality register
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 28.5% walked outdoors at 4 months; about 30% still had pain and used analgesics at 4 months

result.other_findings: Length of stay and in-hospital complications fell between 2011 and 2013.

result.setting: 17 hip fracture registries covering 20 countries
result.standard: Fragility Fracture Network minimum common dataset (2022): 20 core and 12 optional fields

cycle1.result: First-generation registries collect 60% of fields, second-generation 75%, third-generation 85%; 5/20 core fields collected by all; prefracture mobility, cognition and bone protection collected by 11/17 (65%)

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: NHS hospitals in England; national collaborative audit with BOTA
result.standard: Completeness of NJR elbow dataset against Hospital Episode Statistics, and accuracy of recorded components

cycle1.result: Completeness 63%; radial head arthroplasty completeness 35%; accuracy 94%; 5539 unmatched and 448 inaccurate arthroplasties from 254 hospitals

result.intervention: National collaborative audit through trainees: hospitals checked records, added missing arthroplasties and corrected inaccurate ones

cycle2.result: Completeness 83% (total elbow arthroplasty 93%); radial head arthroplasty completeness 70%; accuracy 98% after correcting 212 of 448

result.other_findings: 82% of unmatched records were confirmed missing; radial head arthroplasties drove most of the gap.

result.topic: VTE prophylaxis in foot and ankle surgery
result.setting: 56 UK sites (UK-FATE multicentre prospective audit)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 95 VTE events (0.86%); Achilles tendon rupture 3.7%; below-knee amputation 5.3%

result.other_findings: 12 different chemical prophylaxis agents used; no evidence mechanical prophylaxis reduced VTE.

result.topic: Ipsilateral shoulder pain after thoracic surgery
result.setting: Tertiary referral centre, Brisbane
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Moderate-to-severe ipsilateral shoulder pain in 15.8% of thoracotomy patients; none in VATS patients given phrenic nerve infiltration

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: 50 hospitals in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region
result.standard: Guidelines on daptomycin prescribing (appropriateness assessed by local referent)

cycle1.result: 87.1% (1128) appropriate; of 132 inappropriate prescriptions, 33.3% wrong indication, 25% no de-escalation, 16.7% wrong dose, 15.9% wrong duration

result.other_findings: 44.2% were for bone and joint infections; written infectious disease advice linked to higher appropriateness (94.1% vs 69.9%).

result.setting: 16 hospitals contributing to the Irish Hip Fracture Database (national audit data)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Mean time to surgery 40.9 h (SD 60.3 h); longer time to surgery associated with male sex, higher ASA grade, low pre-morbid mobility, inter-hospital transfer, weekday presentation, pre-operative medical assessment, intracapsular fracture, arthroplasty, general anaesthesia, consultant surgeon and lower orthopaedic surgical capacity.

result.other_findings: Regression analysis of factors associated with time to surgery rather than compliance with a standard; none of four explored protocols for expediting surgery were associated with time to surgery.

result.topic: Regional anaesthesia for hip arthroplasty analgesia
result.setting: Complexo Hospitalario Universitario de A Coruña, anaesthesia department
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Peripheral nerve blocks in 169 patients (66.3% femoral, 27.7% PENG, 6.0% fascia iliaca); mean PACU morphine 2.2 mg with PENG and 3.27 mg with femoral block vs 6.69 mg with no block; no difference in opioid rescues at 24 and 48 h.

result.other_findings: Nerve injury incidence 0.8%, not associated with blocks; prolonged quadriceps paralysis 1.3%, mainly after femoral block (75% of cases).

result.setting: Gynecological and Obstetrical University Hospital Sant'Anna, Turin
result.standard: Five literature-derived quality criteria for elective caesarean section, each with a standard; repeat caesarean rate standard ≤30%

cycle1.result: Most indicators met the standard; caesarean rate for previous caesarean was 84% (73/86) against a standard of ≤30%.

result.other_findings: Authors state the audit led to identification of excess repeat caesareans and a significant reduction of them, and further audits are planned; no re-audit figures given.

result.topic: Foot health care in systemic sclerosis
result.setting: Connective tissue disease outpatient clinic and specialist rheumatology foot health clinic, Chapel Allerton Hospital, Leeds
result.standard: UK PRCA/ARMA standards of care: all people with systemic sclerosis should receive at least basic foot health information, and those with foot problems should have access to self-management advice and care

cycle1.result: Only 35/91 (39%) reported receiving foot health information; 49/91 (54%) had previous access to foot care and 38 (42%) were receiving foot care currently; 54 (59%) had current foot problems.

result.other_findings: Of 55 patients with foot problems, 32 (58%) had received foot health information and 45 (82%) had previous access to foot care, mostly via the hospital rheumatology foot clinic (29, 53%).

result.setting: UK secondary care centre (Maidstone and Tunbridge Wells Hospital), selective hip ultrasound screening
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: DDH (Graf IIb-IV) in 101 macrosomic female infants, prevalence 14.8% (140.3 per 1000; 95% CI 12.3-17.7).

result.other_findings: Of 123 dysplastic hips, 91.1% were managed with a Pavlik harness with a 96.4% success rate; authors suggest adding birthweight ≥4 kg to UK selective screening criteria.

result.setting: 26 public and private healthcare facilities in the Pays de la Loire regional network
result.standard: French national antibiotic prophylaxis guidelines (use, agent, timing within 60 minutes before incision, initial dose, additional doses)

cycle1.result: Overall antibiotic prophylaxis compliance 64%; correct agent 93%; correct initial dose 97.4%; given within 60 minutes before incision in 77.6%.

result.other_findings: Seven procedures audited including total hip arthroplasty; in 26% of appendicectomies prophylaxis was given after incision. An action plan and updated regional protocol were planned.

result.setting: Rockhampton Hospital, regional Queensland
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 115 TKR and 51 THR patients attended pre-operative education; no difference in hospital costs or length of stay between attenders and non-attenders.

result.other_findings: Total acute stay costs, total costs including travel and education, and comorbidity scores were similar between groups.

result.setting: 10 largest Walk For Life clubfoot clinics
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Two-year outcomes: 99.0% walked independently, 95.5% could run, 93.3% squat, 93.0% manage steps; tenotomy rate 79%; brace use after 2 years 85%.

result.other_findings: Suspected relapse with heel varus (18.0% left, 21.5% right); cost of 3000 Taka was deemed unaffordable by 59% of parents.

result.setting: Multicentre audit in publicly funded health services (FFPOM)
result.standard: British Orthopaedic Association Standard: all surgery in the frail patient should allow full weightbearing for activities required for daily living

cycle1.dates: 1 January 2019 to 30 June 2019, and 1 February 2021 to 14 March 2021
cycle1.result: 16,614 (85.0%) instructed to weightbear for daily living immediately postoperatively: 15,543 (95.7%) hip fracture and 1,071 (32.3%) non-hip fracture patients.

result.other_findings: Median length of stay 12.2 days (IQR 7.9 to 20.0); shaft and distal femur fractures had longer stays than similar hip fracture patients.

result.setting: Australasian College of Podiatric Surgeons online audit tool
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 382 foot and ankle surgery cases captured over 3 months using the new tool; data entry valid and reliable, with 100% surgeon audit participation.

result.other_findings: Development of an audit tool via case study and Delphi survey; an online survey showed high usability.

result.setting: Review of national hip fracture audits
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Narrative review and practical advice on setting up large-scale hip fracture audits.

result.setting: Scottish Hip Fracture Audit and MSK Hip Fracture Audit, participating Scottish hospitals
result.standard: Scottish hip fracture clinical standards including discharge from A&E within 4 h and surgery within 48 h of admission

cycle1.result: Discharge from A&E within 4 h improved from 80.5% (2003) to 96% (2008); surgery within 48 h improved from 89.9% to 98.4%.

result.intervention: Continuous annual audit discontinued in 2008, then re-introduced in 2014

cycle2.result: A&E 4 h improvement not maintained; surgery within 48 h fell to 91.8%.

result.other_findings: 30-day mortality improved and kept improving in 2013; re-introduction of continuous audit in 2014 improved A&E waits and time to theatre again.

result.setting: Thomas Jefferson University Hospital, neurosurgery
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Early complications 47.1% overall; minor 40.5%, major 18.2%.

result.other_findings: Major complications higher in infection (20.0%) and oncologic cases (30.0%) (P=0.07).

result.topic: VTE prophylaxis in lower limb immobilisation
result.setting: Orthopaedic Assessment Unit, Wellington Hospital
result.standard: Local policy to routinely prescribe aspirin 100 mg daily for Achilles tendon injury requiring lower limb immobilisation

cycle1.result: Aspirin prescribed in 0.5%; symptomatic VTE incidence 6.3%.

result.intervention: Introduction of a policy to routinely prescribe aspirin 100 mg daily

cycle2.result: Aspirin prescribed to 189/218 (93%); symptomatic VTE in 14 (6.4%, 95% CI 3.6-10.5%), unchanged.

result.other_findings: All patients who developed VTE had been prescribed aspirin; authors suggest considering LMWH instead.

result.setting: Members of the Pennsylvania Orthopaedic Society, one audited practice day
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Defensive imaging was 19.1% (396) of orders and 34.7% ($113,675) of total cost; 38.5% (193/501) of MRIs ordered defensively.

result.other_findings: Defensive imaging higher in surgeons sued in previous five years (24.6% vs 15.1%) and those in practice over fifteen years (20.8% vs 17.1%).

result.topic: Tranexamic acid use in hip and knee arthroplasty
result.setting: Intervention site anaesthesiology department, Calgary
result.standard: Evidence-based guidelines and local practice protocols supporting tranexamic acid as standard of care in THA and TKA

cycle1.result: TXA use 66.6% for THA and 62.4% for TKA.

result.intervention: Two individual data reports on TXA use and transfusion compared with peers, plus a group-facilitated feedback session

cycle2.result: TXA use 74.4% for THA (absolute change 7.9%, 95% CI 2.4 to 13.3) and 82.3% for TKA (absolute change 19.9%, 95% CI 15.0 to 25.0).

result.other_findings: Dosing also shifted towards evidence-based practice guidelines.

result.topic: MRSA screening in elective orthopaedic patients
result.setting: Elective orthopaedic waiting list, Royal Gwent Hospital, Newport
result.standard: Trust four-site MRSA screening policy (nose, throat, axilla, groin)

cycle1.result: Positive sites: nose 69.60% (n=96), groin 26.10% (n=36), throat 25.30% (n=35), axilla 8.70% (n=12); a nose, groin and throat three-swab policy would miss 2.2%.

result.intervention: Screening policy changed from four-swab to three-swab (nose, throat, groin)

cycle2.result: Audited four times after the change; all were negative (no figures given).

result.other_findings: Two-swab policies would miss 15.20% to 26.8% of carriers; 11 previously negative sites became positive on repeat swabs, so screening only the previous positive site is not recommended.

result.setting: Multi-disciplinary Foot Ulcer Clinic, Royal Perth Hospital
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Complete ulcer healing in 19 (95%) after surgery, mean healing time 61 +/- 44 days, versus mean pre-surgical ulcer duration 468 +/- 410 days; all remained healed at 12 months.

result.setting: Review article
result.standard: not reported

result.topic: VTE after arthroplasty and hip fracture surgery

result.setting: 52 UK sites, trainee-led national collaborative audit (AUGMENT)
result.standard: BOAST 12 (BOA/BOFAS) standards for ankle fractures: documentation, imaging, management and follow-up

cycle1.result: Overall BOAST 12 compliance 41.7%; neurovascular documentation 40.7%; VTE assessment 61.5%.

result.topic: Carbon footprint of shoulder dislocation pathways
result.setting: Emergency department of a major trauma centre in England
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 13 carbon-reduction actions identified, with potential saving of 86.4 kgCO2e per patient.

cycle1.result: 36.5% had preoperative iron studies; of those, 38.5% had anaemia of inflammation, 21.5% IDA, 23.1% normal. 51.5% of patients transfused post-surgery had a discharge Hb ≥110 g/l.

result.other_findings: Iron studies were more often requested postoperatively; restricting discharge Hb to 90 or 100 g/l may have avoided transfusion in 14.8-42.6% of patients.

result.setting: Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital, Mumbai, tertiary care centre; typed EMR operative proforma
result.standard: Royal College of Surgeons Good Surgical Practice guidelines (2014)

cycle1.result: 100% for date/time, surgeon, procedure, extra procedure; operative diagnosis 99.35%; antibiotic prophylaxis 99.35; incision 94.77%; findings 92.16%; prosthesis 97.37%; DVT prophylaxis 96.08%; post-op instructions 93.46%; tourniquet time 41.83%; blood loss 59.48%; closure 16.99%; complications 51.63%; elective/emergency setting 0%.

result.other_findings: Mandated EMR fields were well documented; authors suggest mandating further fields to improve documentation.

result.topic: Non-traumatic spinal cord injury rehabilitation outcomes
result.setting: National Spinal Injuries Centre, Stoke Mandeville Hospital, tertiary spinal cord injury rehabilitation unit
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Degenerative vertebral column disorders, infection and vascular disorders accounted for 80% of NTSCI; infection-related NTSCI had the highest needs.

result.other_findings: Relationship between cause and rehabilitation outcome may be mediated by injury severity.

result.setting: Aberdeen Royal Infirmary
result.standard: ACL reconstruction within 12 months of injury

cycle1.result: Mean time from injury to surgery 14 months (range 3-56).

result.intervention: Acute Knee Clinic established in December 2004.

cycle2.result: 21 Acute Knee Clinic patients: mean 6 months to surgery, 95% within 12 months; 28 elective clinic patients: mean 25 months, 53% within 12 months.

result.other_findings: 90% of A&E referrals were seen by a specialist within four weeks (May 2005 to July 2007); the clinic accounted for only 40% of ACL reconstruction referrals.

result.topic: Hip fracture process of care standards
result.setting: Seven hospitals with trauma orthopaedic departments, East Anglia (multi-site audit)
result.standard: Indicator standards for re-audit circulated after the 1992 audit

cycle1.result: Pharmaceutical thromboembolic prophylaxis 45%; early mobilisation 56%.

result.intervention: Results of the 1992 audit and indicator standards circulated to orthopaedic and care of the elderly consultants and audit leads at each hospital.

cycle2.result: Pharmaceutical thromboembolic prophylaxis 81%; early mobilisation 70%; reduced pneumonia, wound infection, pressure sores and fatal PE.

result.other_findings: No change in 3-month functional outcome or mortality; some hospitals failed to maintain good practice.

result.setting: Clinical Radiology Department, St James's University Hospital, Leeds, large acute hospital
result.standard: NRPB recommendation that CT be clinically justified by an experienced radiologist

cycle1.result: Of 915 examinations for benign disease, 293 (32%) were orthopaedic, including 255 (87%) for back pain; no substantial numbers of inappropriate CT found.

result.other_findings: CT for benign non-orthopaedic disease in 97 women under 50, 49 reported normal; MRI substitution for spine CT suggested.

result.setting: UK GP surgery (Mid and South Essex)
result.standard: NICE CG161/NG5 and NHS England guidance: documented medication review within 4 weeks after a fall; target 100%

cycle1.result: 22% (14/63) documented review within 4 weeks.

result.intervention: Clinician education on NICE guidance, SystmOne prompts and weekly MDT fall reviews.
result.other_findings: More appropriate deprescribing, particularly of benzodiazepines, anticholinergics and antihypertensives.

result.topic: Major orthopaedic trauma in older people
result.setting: Trauma Audit Research Network database, England and Wales
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 72,942 of 142,765 adults (51.09%) had long bone or pelvic fractures; 30-day mortality 6.8% in older v. 2.5% in younger; critical care episodes 9.7% v. 18.2%.

result.other_findings: Older patients were often managed by surgeons in isolation; authors call for shared orthogeriatric care models.

result.topic: Fascia iliaca block for hip fracture
result.setting: Emergency departments, Royal University Hospital, Saskatoon (University of Saskatchewan)
result.standard: Target fascia iliaca block in 50% of hip fracture patients within 18 months

cycle1.result: Baseline fascia iliaca block rate 2.0%; 6 physicians performing it.

result.intervention: Three PDSA cycles: educational materials and standardised equipment carts; staff and trainee education sessions; further education, audit and feedback, and incentives.

cycle2.result: Fascia iliaca block rate 22.6%; 35 physicians performing it; special cause variation (shift) on SPC chart.

result.other_findings: Target of 50% not met; one adverse event (arterial puncture) without significant harm.

result.setting: UK-FATE national prospective audit, 68 UK centres
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Symptomatic VTE after ATR 3.69% (n = 40) v. 0.57% (n = 59) after other foot and ankle surgery.

result.other_findings: No significant difference in VTE by chemical prophylaxis, weight-bearing or immobilisation strategy; VTE patients were older.

result.setting: Scottish Hip Fracture Audit data, Scottish hospitals
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 9867 (72%) received SHS; no significant difference in 30-day (OR 1.05) or 60-day (OR 1.10) survival; lower early mobilisation with IMN (OR 0.64, 95% CI 0.59-0.70).

result.other_findings: SHS associated with early mobilisation, reduced length of stay and likely lower cost.

result.setting: Gold Coast Hospital and Health Service, 2-campus tertiary hospital
result.standard: Australian national cell salvage guidelines

cycle1.result: 79% compliance with national guidelines; orthopaedics used most cases (22.9%, n = 108).

result.other_findings: Highest average return in vascular surgery (699 mL) and urology (654 mL); revision (7.6%) and primary (6.6%) THR among most common procedures.

result.setting: 10 PREDICT paediatric emergency departments (clinical audit), 13 (organisational audit)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 196 migraine, 197 abdominal pain, 177 femur fracture cases. Less than half had pain score at triage. Femur fractures: analgesia 78% (opioids 49%, femoral nerve blocks 40%); median 75 min to enteral and 26 min to parenteral medication.

result.other_findings: 92% of EDs had pain policies but only 15% had pain quality improvement programmes; femoral nerve blocks underused.

result.topic: Blood test requesting in acute admissions
result.setting: Trauma and orthopaedic department, NHS Tayside, Dundee; acute admissions
result.standard: Locally developed multidisciplinary blood requesting guidelines

cycle1.result: LFTs 895, coagulation/INR 307, CRP 894; mean 4.81 requests per patient (SD 4.75); cost £2674.14.

result.intervention: Clinical guidelines for blood requesting developed with multidisciplinary input and implemented in the department.
result.other_findings: Reduced venepuncture rates as well as cost.

result.setting: Journal of Clinical Orthopaedics and Trauma, SCOPUS and PubMed data
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Submissions increased 2.8 times and citations 16.6 times in 2019 compared with 2015; journal cited 1702 times.

result.other_findings: More higher level of evidence papers being published.

result.setting: National Joint Registry for England and Wales
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.dates: 1 April 2007 to 31 March 2008 (procedures 1 January to 31 December 2007)
cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Report includes revision rates, mortality and pulmonary embolism using linked HES and PEDW data.

result.setting: Midfoot and forefoot surgery under ankle block (Flinders University)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 3.1% complained of tourniquet pain; 0.4% converted to general anaesthesia; 97.2% would have surgery again with an ankle tourniquet.

result.other_findings: Tourniquet pain associated with age and tourniquet time; patients 70 or older had 3.5 times more tourniquet pain.

result.setting: Department of Orthopaedic and Trauma Surgery, University of Oulu
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 63% of surgeries delayed more than 24 hours; all received LMWH; 92% received antibiotic prophylaxis; deep infection 2.5%.

result.other_findings: Describes the extended SAHFE data set; function significantly impaired at four months.

result.setting: Emergency departments, national audit of public trauma hospitals
result.standard: Pre-defined audit criteria for AP and axillary/Velpeau views

cycle1.result: Two views in 75.92% (n = 599); axillary or Velpeau view in 21.17% (n = 167); AP view met audit criteria in 23.09% (n = 181).

result.other_findings: Surgeon survey (70.8% response): 88.2% favoured three views and 94% a national protocol.

result.setting: Rheumatology follow-up clinics in 10 West Midlands units
result.standard: National Osteoporosis Society 1998 guidance; 80% of eligible patients on appropriate therapy

cycle1.result: 148 (63%) on appropriate osteoporosis medication; 202 (86%) on any treatment; DXA in 102 (43.4%). Region failed the standard.

result.other_findings: Of 87 inappropriately treated, 71 (81.6%) under-treated and 16 (18.4%) over-treated; re-audit planned in 2 years.

result.setting: Groote Schuur Hospital Trauma Unit, urban tertiary trauma unit, Cape Town
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 7350 interpersonal violence and 3188 motor vehicle collision attendances; weekends, month-end and long weekends busier.

result.other_findings: Soccer matches had no significant effect on violence-related attendances.

result.topic: Resuscitation discussion before hip fracture surgery
result.setting: Rowley Bristow Unit, St Peter's Hospital, Chertsey
result.standard: ReSPECT form completed before operation and countersigned by a consultant

cycle1.result: ReSPECT form completion 23%; consultant signed 41%.

result.other_findings: Education produced only limited improvement.

result.setting: Paediatric dental trauma clinic, Glasgow Dental Hospital
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Males 60% of trauma; falls 49%, sport 18%; peak age 8-11 years (43%).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Angus, Dundee Teaching Hospitals and Perth & Kinross Trusts, Tayside
result.standard: Previously agreed standards for administration of antibiotic prophylaxis (three general standards)

cycle1.result: Prophylaxis given to 82% of eligible orthopaedic patients; rate for indicated operations 84% to 93% across trusts; continued <24 h in 78% to 97%; given within two hours in >95%; second doses in 5/44 (11%) of operations >2 h.

result.other_findings: Trust comparison confined to six common procedures (166 operations) because results were sensitive to case mix.

result.setting: Six Finnish hospitals
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: After adjustment, significant differences in post-fracture walking ability and mortality between centres but not in place of residence.

result.other_findings: Use of sliding hip screw v. Gamma Nail differed most between hospitals.

result.setting: Alexandra Hospital, Redditch, district general hospital, A&E department
result.standard: Transfer from A&E to ward within 1 hour

cycle1.result: Mean transfer time 2 h 45 min ± 57 min (median 2 h 40 min); 3/104 within 1 hour.

result.intervention: Fast tracking protocol for transfer of hip fracture patients from A&E to ward, implemented December 1997.

cycle2.result: Mean 1 h 32 min ± 40.87 min (median 1 h 25 min), p<0.001; 24/90 within 1 hour, p<0.001.

result.other_findings: 10 of 100 patients not fast tracked (multiple injuries, medical problems, unclear diagnosis) averaged 2 h 55 min in A&E.

result.setting: Gold Coast Public Hospital emergency departments
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 1512 presentations (56.4%) required orthopaedic management; lacerations 37.9%, ligament injury 21.3%, fractures 12.2%.

result.other_findings: 93.5% were discharged without admission.

result.topic: MRSA eradication and antibiotic prophylaxis in hip fracture surgery
result.setting: Royal Liverpool Hospital, UK major trauma centre, emergency hip fracture surgery
result.standard: Local MRSA guidelines: eradication therapy and correct induction antibiotics for MRSA-unknown patients

cycle1.result: Eradication therapy prescribed 1%; correct antibiotic choice 18%. Operation median 24.05 h from admission but MRSA swab results at median 48 h.

result.intervention: Posters on induction antibiotics in anaesthetic rooms and stickers on MRSA eradication therapy on nursing care bundles.

cycle2.result: Eradication therapy prescribed 8%; correct antibiotic choice 94%.

result.other_findings: Eradication therapy compliance stayed poor despite stickers.

result.setting: 18 Scottish hospitals; linked Scottish Hip Fracture Audit and national blood transfusion data
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Transfusion rate 28.7% (n = 6,685); inter-hospital range 16.6% to 37.4%.

result.other_findings: Transfusion associated with adverse outcomes, most likely reflecting perioperative anaemia.

result.topic: Clinical photography in foot ulcer monitoring
result.setting: High Risk Foot Clinic, Liverpool Hospital, NSW
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 731 charts had a photograph; 623 (85%) of good quality. Probe to bone completed 99%, antibiotic 97%, offloading device 81%, Texas classification 76%.

result.other_findings: Completion followed item position on the form; commonest photography error was not using macro setting.

result.setting: Physiotherapy-led primary care musculoskeletal service, York and Scarborough
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 58 of 102 patients without hydrodistension required onward orthopaedic referral.

result.intervention: Physiotherapist-performed ultrasound-guided hydrodistension introduced to the frozen shoulder pathway in 2017.

cycle2.result: 6 of 102 patients receiving hydrodistension required onward orthopaedic referral.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Two trauma and orthopaedic wards, London hospital
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 17 (43%) rated sleep poor; 19 (46%) said sleep affected recovery; noise main disruptor (n = 26, 65%).

result.other_findings: Authors call for a standardised sleep assessment and audit tool.

result.setting: Orthopaedics Department, Centro Hospitalar de São João, Porto, university hospital
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Compared with control, fluoroquinolone use fell by 2.3 DDD/1000 patient-days per month (95% CI -3.97 to -0.63); penicillin use rose by 103.3 DDD/1000 patient-days at implementation then declined (slope -5.2).

result.intervention: Prospective audit and feedback antimicrobial stewardship intervention starting 1 January 2015.
result.other_findings: Controlled interrupted time series; intervention reduced antibiotic exposure and spectrum in osteoarticular and prosthetic joint infections.

result.setting: UK Anaesthesia Sprint Audit of Practice data with linked outcomes
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Mortality 165/11,085 (1.5%) at 5 days and 563/11,085 (5.1%) at 30 days; not associated with anaesthetic technique; risk rose as blood pressure fell.

result.other_findings: Higher spinal bupivacaine volume weakly correlated with larger falls in systolic blood pressure.

result.setting: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Kent and Sussex Hospital, Tunbridge Wells
result.standard: Information on BOA-endorsed Orthoconsent forms as the set standard for patient understanding at confirmation of consent

cycle1.result: Patients consented with standard yellow generic forms scored an average of 56.7% (knee arthroscopy) and 57.6% (total knee replacement) on questionnaires.

result.intervention: Patients additionally given the procedure-specific Orthoconsent form to read at home and sign on the morning of surgery.

cycle2.result: Average scores rose to 80.5% (knee arthroscopy) and 81.6% (total knee replacement).

result.other_findings: 100 knee arthroscopy and 60 total knee replacement patients took part in total; questionnaires had 26 (KA) or 35 (TKR) questions.

result.setting: Orthopaedic Unit, Alice Springs Hospital (rural hospital)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 114 hand infection admissions, 87 (76%) in Indigenous patients; MRSA rate 24.6%; Indigenous patients 9.52 times more likely to be re-admitted (P = 0.038).

result.other_findings: Indigenous and older patients had longer admissions; MRSA was associated with smoking and substance abuse.

result.setting: Orthogeriatric unit (experimental group) with a conventional orthopaedic unit as control
result.standard: Receipt of acetaminophen 3 g/day during the three postoperative days, and nurses' adherence to medical prescriptions

cycle1.result: 16% of patients in the experimental group received 3 g/day of acetaminophen postoperatively before the intervention.

result.intervention: Audit and feedback intervention built with nurses.

cycle2.result: 60% received 3 g/day of acetaminophen after the intervention; likelihood of receiving 3 g/day and prescription adherence significantly increased versus control.

result.other_findings: 398 patients in total (mean age 89 years); functional status at discharge was better and length of stay shorter after the intervention.

result.setting: Departments of Radiology and Orthopaedic Surgery, Royal Devon and Exeter Hospital
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Significant improvement in pain at rest, on activity and function in both insertional and non-insertional groups over two years.

result.other_findings: Satisfaction scores improved significantly in the non-insertional group but not the insertional group.

result.setting: Quality improvement collaborative across 19 hospitals in Flanders
result.standard: Adherence to 23 quality indicators for geriatric hip fracture care

cycle1.result: Lowest adherence: nerve blocks 8.0%, steroids 9.7%, tranexamic acid 22.2%.

result.intervention: Anonymous benchmarking fed back to centres and three educative sessions on specific topics.

cycle2.result: Nerve blocks 25.4%, steroids 26.4%, tranexamic acid 30.7% (significant improvement).

result.other_findings: 1044 patients were included across both retrospective audits.

result.topic: Gentamicin prophylaxis for urinary catheter manipulation
result.setting: Antimicrobial stewardship team, 500-bed tertiary regional hospital (Wollongong Hospital)
result.standard: Australian Therapeutic Guidelines: Antibiotic (no recognised indication for gentamicin IDC prophylaxis)

cycle1.result: Gentamicin given for IDC insertion in 59/137 (42%) operations.

result.intervention: Results presented to surgeons, literature review, consensus to discontinue gentamicin IDC prophylaxis, with weekly feedback to the Head of Orthopaedics.

cycle2.result: Gentamicin for IDC insertion fell to 4/205 (2%).

result.other_findings: Regular rolling audits and timely feedback helped sustain the change.

result.topic: National Hip Fracture Database data accuracy

result.standard: Accuracy of NHFD entries for operation, implant polarity and cementation

cycle1.result: Inaccuracies in 20.5% of 3972 data entries.

result.intervention: Introduction of a hip fracture clinical data administrator in each centre.

cycle2.result: Inaccuracies reduced to 5.2% of 559 data entries.

result.other_findings: Authors advise caution when using NHFD data for research and audit.

result.setting: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Princess Royal Hospital, Haywards Heath
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: PACU admissions 22%, mortality 6.1%, HDU length of stay 2.1 days, ICU unplanned admissions 1.3%, ICU length of stay 2.3 days.

result.intervention: Multidisciplinary anaesthetic-led preoperative assessment clinic started in April 2006.

cycle2.result: PACU admissions 10%, mortality 1.2% (p = 0.001); HDU length of stay 1.6 days, ICU unplanned admissions 0.4%, ICU length of stay 1.9 days (p = 0.01).

result.other_findings: Estimated cost savings of nearly £50,000 in the second period.

result.setting: Department of Trauma and Orthopaedics, Northwest General Hospital and Research Centre, Peshawar
result.standard: Royal College of Surgeons of England operation note guidelines (19 parameters)

cycle1.result: 64 notes (45 (70%) typewritten); 64 (100%) compliant for surgeon name, operative procedure, diagnosis and post-op instructions.

result.intervention: Findings presented in ward meetings with surgeons and educational workshops arranged.

cycle2.result: Average improvement of 40 (31.1%), with 17 of 19 categories improving.

result.other_findings: 128 notes reviewed in total; 50 (78%) of post-intervention notes were typewritten.

result.setting: East Sussex Healthcare Trust, elective shoulder surgery
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Grade 1 (complete agreement) 87.0% (n = 47), Grade 2 9.3% (n = 5), Grade 3 3.7% (n = 2); 96% closely correlated with surgical findings.

result.other_findings: Ultrasound was more accurate than MRI for full-thickness rotator cuff tears but unreliable in patients with BMI ≥ 35.

result.topic: Falls prevention and management in inpatients
result.setting: Woodlands Hospital, inpatient old age psychiatric unit
result.standard: NICE guidelines on the management of falls in older people

cycle1.result: 100% had individualised interventions; 97.3% had falls risk assessment on admission; 60.3% checked for signs of fracture; 78.3% had physical examination within 12 hours; 75% had neurological observations.

result.other_findings: Weekly MDT falls risk review, fracture checks and neurological examination need improvement; re-audit planned for September 2021.

result.setting: GP practice with a population of 14,000
result.standard: Local secondary-care-developed osteoporosis treatment pathway

cycle1.result: 75% of patients followed the local guidelines pathway.

cycle2.result: 81% of patients followed the local guidelines pathway.

result.other_findings: Practice clinical system searches identified uncoded or untreated patients with osteoporosis or fragility fracture.

result.topic: Blood transfusion in lower limb arthroplasty
result.setting: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Royal Preston Hospital
result.standard: not reported

cycle2.result: 24% required blood (11% of knees, 34% of hips); mean 0.56 units per patient (0.26 knees, 0.79 hips).

result.other_findings: Prospective audits of 38 knees and 41 hips, then 35 knees and 47 hips.

result.topic: Hip fracture data quality: audit versus register data
result.setting: Kuusankoski Regional Hospital with Finnish Health Care Register and Causes of Death Register
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Register accuracy of easily measurable variables at least 95%; agreement with audit data 86.3% for detailed hip fracture diagnosis; polyserial correlation 0.68 for functional dependency.

result.other_findings: Register data lack clinical detail but outperform prospective data for inpatient care history.

result.topic: Red flag documentation in low back pain
result.setting: 14 NHS health boards in Scotland plus two private provider sites (physiotherapy services)
result.standard: Evidence- and consensus-based guideline recommendations on red flag assessment in low back pain

cycle1.result: Documentation of all red flags 33% (n=709); cauda equina syndrome 60% (n=1288).

cycle2.result: Documentation of all red flags 65% (n=1396); cauda equina syndrome 84% (n=1804).

result.other_findings: Data from 2147 patients; only two regions documented all cauda equina components 100%, and one in five patients still did not receive optimal management.

result.setting: Division of Maxillofacial and Oral Surgery, Chris Hani Baragwanath Hospital
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 95 condylar fractures; 73.8% from interpersonal violence; 73 (87%) unilateral; Type I 31%, Type II 26%, Type III 25%.

result.setting: Orthopaedic outpatients, Princess Royal Hospital, Haywards Heath

result.setting: Fracture clinic, Department of Orthopaedics, Frimley Park Hospital
result.standard: not reported

result.setting: Orthopaedic unit, Southampton General Hospital
result.standard: not reported

result.setting: Multicentre national collaborative audit across NHS trusts

result.topic: Multimodal oral analgesia after spine surgery

result.standard: not reported

result.setting: Emergency department, Sunshine Coast University Hospital

result.topic: Best practice tariff compliance for hip and knee replacement

result.setting: Lincoln County Hospital and GP practices in its catchment
